Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in the initial "Information Gathering" step by incorrectly identifying the husband of Caterina Visconti as Gian Galeazzo Visconti. Caterina Visconti was the daughter of Bernabò Visconti and married several people, most notably Filippo Maria Visconti (her brother-in-law) and later Francesco Sforza. While she was related to Gian Galeazzo Visconti (her brother), she was not his wife. Consequently, the Planner directed the WebSurfer to search for the wrong person, leading to the incorrect conclusion that the husband was born in Milan.
